title: What if Earth stopped orbiting the Sun? ☀️
subject: sun
description:
How many days would you last? 👇

What would happen if Earth suddenly stopped orbiting the Sun? With no sideways speed, gravity would pull us straight in, and the fall would take about 64 days. Calculations put the oceans boiling around day 47. It's a thought experiment: nothing could really stop Earth's orbit.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine ("If Earth's Orbit Stopped, We Would Have About a Month to Contemplate Our Doom", citing Aatish Bhatia's calculations for WIRED), Cornell University Ask an Astronomer via Universe Today

scenes.text: Without Earth's orbit, you'd hit the Sun in 64 days.
Our sideways speed is the only thing keeping us from falling, so without it, gravity pulls us straight in.
After 3 weeks, the average temperature passes 95 degrees Fahrenheit, and crops fail.
Around day 47, the oceans boil away, weeks before we even arrive.
And on day 64, the Sun's gravity tears Earth apart before it ever touches the surface.
